name: Tourist / Business e-Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Foreign nationals requiring a visa apply online through an electronic visa system for tourist or business purposes. The visa is valid 1 year with multiple entries. Processing now takes around 15 days (down from roughly 6 weeks under the prior paper-based system), and the fee has risen to USD 180 (from USD 60). Applicants receive an electronic visa by email, print it, and present it at the border -- no in-person consular interview or physical passport stamp is required beforehand.
requirements.fix_path: Apply online for the e-visa, allowing roughly 15 days for processing.

sources.title: Fragomen -- Venezuela's new electronic visa system for tourist/business travel: 1-year multiple-entry validity, 15-day processing, USD 180 fee
